# argos-module-policy

License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (`LICENSE.md`): source-available, free for
individuals and noncommercial use; companies and other commercial entities need a
commercial licence with Argos maintenance keys (`COMMERCIAL.md`). Not open source
in the OSI sense.

Rights (`Capability`), service settings (`ServicePolicy`) and `Approval` of
Argos modules, shared by the sandbox and the governance core. No key, no
ledger, no signature.
